paragraphs.text: Dean Augusta Tullus was a human cleric teacher at the Lorehold College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios . After being killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion , she returned as an animated spirit statue, resuming her role as dean.

Augusta Tullus, a professor of spirit studies, has been called the college's most talented pastraiser; she can not only summon ghostly historical figures but also conjure entire dioramas of historical events for her lectures.

Augusta believes that history repeats itself as orderly progress toward an ideal. She believes that the mistakes of the past can inform the choices of the present, creating a world of peace, order, and rules. She plays things very by the book and is highly disappointed with students who embark on Dean Plargg 's dangerous field trips.

Believing that a consistent transition of authority between deans was important for the success and well-being of Lorehold students, Augusta prepared for her inevitable demise, crafting a ritual that allowed her to be summoned shortly after her death. As a result, her spirit serves as the interim dean of order despite her death in the New Phyrexian Invasion . Like all Lorehold-summoned spirits, she is merely the essence of her past self and is constrained in her use of magic, although she still provides instruction and advice to students in spirit summoning.

During her tenure as Dean of Order at Lorehold , Augusta Tullus fell under the influence of a dangerous magical relic known as Murgaxor's orb , a glass artifact recovered during an expedition to the Fortress Badlands. Unbeknownst to her colleagues, the orb served as a conduit for the long-banished mage Murgaxor Grenshel , who used it to exert control over Tullus's mind and actions. While under this influence, Tullus became a woman of contrasts, both seen to be far warmer and touchier than normal with students, making sure to shake hands or pat backs whenever the chance presented itself, but also at the same time more cold and aloof, often uncharacteristically withdrawing from her usual duties and concealing herself within the Deans' Repository, an extradimensional archive accessible only through a hidden portal in the Deans' Wing, where she let the glass orb's sickly green light bathe over her. Unbeknownst to anyone, her touch transferred the orb's curse to others, causing sickness, hallucinations, and bouts of unconsciousness. When confronted in the Deans' Repository, she acted erratically and aggressively, speaking in a mechanical tone and commanding defensive constructs to attack intruders. Ultimately, Tullus was incapacitated and separated from the orb, freeing her from Murgaxor's control when the orb was destroyed. Following the incident, she regained her usual demeanor and resumed her position and, though shaken, worked quietly to contain the matter within the faculty.

Augusta was killed while defending her school in the New Phyrexian Invasion . She nevertheless returned as an animated spirit statue herself, to continue in her role as interim dean while she searches for a replacement. As she knows that over time her form will deteriorate, she is focused on finding and training an appropriate successor to her position who can stand up to Plargg's chaotic ways.
